name: What is the difference between handyman repair services and a full remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between handyman repair services and a full remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Handyman services handle routine maintenance, minor drywall patching, trim replacement, fixture swaps, and small tile fixes. A general contracting remodel involves structural alterations, whole-room reconfigurations like full kitchen or bathroom overhauls, and permitted trade work. If your task involves basic wear and tear or localized repairs, a handyman visit is ideal. When projects require moving load-bearing walls or extensive plumbing and electrical rough-ins, they shift into larger remodeling contracts. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra assesses the scope to determine whether small repairs suffice or if integrated trade coordination is required.
acceptedAnswer.description: Handyman services cover localized fixes like drywall patches and trim repair, while remodeling involves structural changes, full room redesigns, and coordinated trade work.
